reviews.title: Brilliant but not Quite - Support is redundant
reviews.text:
Tried to reach out to the Help desk a couple of times, they don’t responded. 

I’m using the app to qualify noise nuisance, I purchased the app for months. Love everything about but it just fools down when it comes to reviewing and capturing the Audio. (It works then it doesn’t work I tried many different settings) 

It seems to be using the wrong microphone to record as there is three on the PRO MAX Module.  Big bangs or even heavy footsteps or running the app struggles to record its not even close to how it’s sounds. 

I have had to revert back to TW Recorder no where near as sophisticated but gives you control of the microphones and pick up all sound at just about every level.  

The db level seems accurate but not the sound capture. 

Some support please or an update to fix would be great.

The HTML export brilliant idea but practicality will open for 100% of people no 

Also looks like there is some bugs to be fixed due to 17 Pro architecture IOS26 update.
